variant_reviews.comparison: For each Z block k compute bar_x_k=(1/K_X)*sum_{ell=1}^{K_X} x_{(k-1)*K_X+ell}, then subtract the vectorized outer product of X-ones with bar_x. The block size is K_X and there are K_Z blocks; transposing this convention would remove different means. Require K_X>0 for the intended average and prove linearity and Pi(Pi x)=Pi x. Its fixed-point space consists of zero within-block sums; in Euclidean coordinates this is orthogonal mean removal, not a population conditional-expectation operator or empirical spline design projection. Theorem 6 minimizes its Rayleigh quotient only over vectors satisfying Pi x=x, so it cannot be replaced by the full covariance matrix's minimum eigenvalue. Generic matrix operations do not supply that nondegeneracy condition.

variant_reviews.comparison: The property is m-hat_{a*f-hat}(Z)=a*m-hat_f(Z) for every a>0, so it concerns the fitted regression rule when its response function is rescaled. It is not merely linearity of the population conditional expectation, and positive homogeneity alone does not imply additivity or the same rule at negative scales or a=0. A design-fixed smoothing matrix gives one candidate proof by linearity, but refitting with response-dependent penalties, tuning or random choices may change the matrix and needs separate verification. Preserve the source's evaluation at Z and selected split convention; do not claim every learner satisfies the property or strengthen it to full linearity.
